3GPP TSG-RAN WG3 Meeting #112e R3-211934 17~27 May 2021 Online Title: [Draft] Reply LS on signaling SN initiated release of SCG Response to: R2-2102493 Release: Rel-15 Work Item: NR_newRAT-Core Source: Samsung[To be RAN3] To: RAN2 Cc: - Contact Person: Name: Weiwei Wang E-mail Address: ww1016.wang@samsung.com Send any reply LS to: 3GPP Liaisons Coordinator, mailto:3GPPLiaison@etsi.org Attachments: R3-21xxxx Overall Description: RAN3 thanks RAN2 for the LS on SN-initiated SCG release. RAN3 has discussed this issue, and confirm that the SN-initiated SCG release while keeping SDAP/PDCP terminating at SN is a valid scenario. The current X2 signaling can support this scenario by setting SCG resources as “not present”. However, there is no Xn signaling to support this case. Thus, RAN3 decides to add new IE, i.e., SCG Release, in S-NODE MODIFICATION REQUIRED message to indicate the SCG release to the MN. The agreed CRs are attached for the information. 2. Actions: To RAN2: ACTION: RAN3 respectfully asks RAN2 to take the above into account. 3. Date of Next TSG-RAN3 Meetings: TSG-RAN3 Meeting #113e 23th - 27th Aug. 2021 Online TSG-RAN3 Meeting #114e 1st - 12th Nov. 2021 Online

Sophia Antipolis, France, 10-14 Oct, 2016 Agenda item: 17 Document for: Approval Introduction This contribution listed the discussion and agreements for the work item of Flexible eNB ID and Cell ID in EUTRAN. RAN3#93bis This was the first meeting for the work item. There were 10 contributions submitted in the meeting. The discussions include following aspects There were three discussion paper R3-162228,R3-162321 and R3-162430 treated, which review the outcome and study item, and following agreements reached during the online and offline discussion: - one long and one short extended eNB ID will be introduced - short Macro eNB ID: 18bits - long Macro eNB ID: 21 bits It was also a consensus that to extend the eNB-ID to 22 bits is more future prove. However the WID rapporteur indicated that they only see the need for 21 bits eNB-ID. Further extension, if needed, can be solved by solution not impacting standard, e.g. multiple PLMN ID. The BL CRs for TS36.300, TS36.413,TS 36.423, TS 25.413, TS 36.463 and TS 36.443 were endorsed as the baseline, which reflecting the agreements above. An LS was agreed to inform CT1, CT4, SA5 and RAN6 about the agreements.

3GPP TSG-RAN3 Meeting #112-e R3-211428 Electronic meeting, 17 - 27 May 2021 3GPP TSG-RAN2 Meeting #113-e R2-2102493 electronic meeting, online, 25th Jan - 5th Feb 2020 Title: LS on signalling SN initiated release of SCG Response to: Release: Rel 15 Work Item: NR_newRAT-Core Source: 3GPP RAN2 To: 3GPP RAN3 Cc: Contact Person: Name: Himke van der Velde E-mail Address: himke.vandervelde@samsung.com Send any reply LS to: 3GPP Liaisons Coordinator, mailto:3GPPLiaison@etsi.org Attachments: 1. Overall description: RAN2 discussed the case in which SN wants to initiate release of the SCG resources while DRBs may still remain SN terminated (i.e., an SCG release request initiated by the SN). Actions: To 3GPP RAN3 ACTION: RAN2 respectfully asks RAN3 to clarify whether, in current X2/Xn signaling, SN can indicate SCG release request to the MN. 3. Date of next TSG RAN WG2 meetings: RAN2#113-bis-e 12th April – 20th April 2021 Online RAN2#114-e 19th May – 27th May 2021 Online

3GPP TSG-RAN3 Meeting #105 R3-193317 Ljubljana, Slovenia, 26-30 August 2019 3GPP TSG RAN WG2#106 R2-1908487 Reno, Nevada, USA, 13 – 17 May, 2019 Title: Reply LS on PDCCH monitoring for NR-DC Response to: R1-1905689/ R2-1905509 Release: Rel-15 Work Item: NR_newRAT-Core Source: RAN WG2 To: RAN WG1 CC: RAN WG3 Contact Person: Name: Himke van der Velde E-mail Address: himke.vandervelde@samsung.com Attachments: R2-1908377 (38.331), and R2-1906822 (38.306) 1. Overall Description: RAN2 would like thank RAN1 for the LS on PDCCH monitoring for NR-DC. RAN2 agreed to introduce to the configuration, capability and inter-node parameters as requested by RAN1, see the attached CRs. RAN2 would like to point out that both for the configuration and the capabilities, a reference to RAN1 specifications was added rather than specifying the constraints that apply regarding the setting of these fields. 2. Actions: To RAN WG2 ACTION: RAN2 kindly asks RAN1 to take the above into consideration, in particular that RAN2 assumes that RAN1 will specify the constraints that apply regarding the setting of configuration and UE capability parameters. 3. 3GPP TSG-RAN3 Meeting #102 R3-186581 Spokane, WA, USA, 12-16 November 2018 Title: [DRAFT] LS on PDU session split Release: Rel-15 Work Item: NR_newRAT-Core Source: Samsung [to be RAN3] To: SA2 Cc: Contact Person: Name: Hong Wang Tel. Number: E-mail Address: hong.wang@samsung.com Send any reply LS to: 3GPP Liaisons Coordinator, mailto:3GPPLiaison@etsi.org Attachments: R3-18xxxx 1. Overall Description: RAN3 has discussed the issues for PDU session split. RAN3 decides that NG-RAN can request the additional TNL information from the 5GC when the NG-RAN decides there are two NG-U tunnel terminations at the NG-RAN. The 5GC provides one additional UL TNL information per PDU session to the NG-RAN based on the request. A new class 1 message is defined in NG interface as in the attachment. In case the 5GC can not provide additional UL TNL information for the request PDU session, the NG-RAN can not setup two NG-U tunnel terminations per PUD session. 2. o, US, 14-18 Nov, 2016 Agenda item: 17 Document for: Approval Introduction This contribution listed the discussion and agreements for the work item of Flexible eNB ID and Cell ID in EUTRAN. RAN3#94 It was agreed to put the note in the MCC minute instead of current draft stage 2 TS 36.300 CR in R3-162713: the eNB may differentiate the length of macro eNB ID by configuration. The BL CRs for TS36.300, TS36.413,TS 36.423, TS 25.413, TS 36.463 and TS 36.443 were endorsed with some editorial updates. RAN3#93bis This was the first meeting for the work item. There were 10 contributions submitted in the meeting. The discussions include following aspects There were three discussion paper R3-162228,R3-162321 and R3-162430 treated, which review the outcome and study item, and following agreements reached during the online and offline discussion: - one long and one short extended eNB ID will be introduced - short Macro eNB ID: 18bits - long Macro eNB ID: 21 bits It was also a consensus that to extend the eNB-ID to 22 bits is more future prove. The BL CRs for TS36.300, TS36.413,TS 36.423, TS 25.413, TS 36.463 and TS 36.443 were endorsed as the baseline, which reflecting the agreements above. An LS was agreed to inform CT1, CT4, SA5 and RAN6 about the agreements.

At RAN #82 meeting, normative work of Remote Interference Management (RIM) for NR was added to the WID of Cross Link Interference (CLI) handling [1]. RAN3 related objectives are identified as below, Specify the inter-set RIM backhaul signalling via the core network to convey the messages of “RIM-RS detected” and “RIM-RS disappeared [RAN3] Identify corresponding OAM functions to support RIM operation [RAN1, RAN3]. In this contribution, we first review RAN1 conclusions that may have impact on RAN3 and further analyze the advantages and drawbacks of the two candidate solutions for inter-set RIM backhaul signaling. The impacts on OAM are also identified.
